Review fix pushed (head 5fc71cf2): pinning tests only, no product code changed. The PR stays a draft.

**Held::simulate_box**
- `stock_sim::held::tests::a_burn_on_a_carried_column_grid_is_the_plain_grid_burn` (app lib, new `crates/app/src/stock_sim_held_tests.rs`): the same burn on `Held::Carried(CarriedStock::Column)` (a body carried through the identity turn) gives the same column tops, bit for bit, as on `Held::Plain(Stock::Column)`. It also checks the cavity floor at 14 inside the gap-grown face and the untouched top at 20 just outside it.
- `stock_sim::held::tests::the_field_arms_refuse_a_burn_by_name`: the plain and the carried field arms both return `ELECTRODE_FIELD_REFUSAL`.
- `sinker_burn_held::the_field_engine_refuses_a_burn_by_name`: under `with_carry_engine(Field)`, `simulate_document` returns exactly `"Burn1: " + ELECTRODE_FIELD_REFUSAL`. The column engine judges the same document.
- `sinker_burn_held::the_field_view_refuses_a_burn_by_name`: `field_view_with` (through `display_inputs`) refuses with the same text.

**Finding: the carried column arm cannot be reached through the document walk.** `carry_turn` refuses any carry onto a non-mill machine (`CARRY_MACHINE_REFUSAL`), so two sinker setups linked "Same as" are refused before any burn meets a carried grid. That is why the carried-equality test runs on the holder (unit test) and not on a document. `sinker_burn_held::a_carry_onto_the_sinker_is_refused_by_name_before_any_burn` pins the refusal. This is safe (a refusal, never a wrong cut), but the refusal text says "a lathe or mill-turn machine" for an EDM. That wording is filed as #1182 (P2), outside this PR.

**family_at_post**
- `sinker_burn_held::the_post_admits_a_burn_on_its_sinker`: `op_streams` posts Burn0 on the sinker.
- `sinker_burn_held::the_post_refuses_a_milling_op_remounted_onto_the_sinker_by_name`: a Face is generated on the default mill, then the sinker is mounted under it. `op_streams` returns exactly "Face1: a Face operation cannot run on its setup's sinker EDM machine - mount a machine that runs it, or suppress the operation". After undo it posts again.
- `sinker_burn_held::a_burn_remounted_onto_a_mill_never_posts`: this case never reaches the family door. The condition's gap is in the burn's stamp, so remounting on a mill makes the burn read Stale and it is refused by name earlier ("Burn0: inputs moved since generation"). Regenerating it on the mill is refused as well. The family door's text is pinned by the Face case above.

The #541 fixtures moved to `crates/app/tests/edm/sinker_fixture.rs`, which `sinker_burn` and `sinker_burn_held` both use.

**Results** (macOS, debug, sccache): sinker_burn 7/7, sinker_burn_held 6/6, app lib 145/145 (2 new), sim lib 73/73, setup_carry 9/9, carried_engine_agreement 1/1 (+1 ignored), carried_fixtures_cache 6/6, carried_verify 8/8, edm_machine 5/5, edm_conditions 1/1. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-sim --tests -- -D warnings` is clean.

**Delta review (M5, since 50e395e8): ready for the maintainer to merge (after #551 → #560).** The only new commit is 5fc71cf2: **tests only**, plus a `#[cfg(test)]` module line in `stock_sim_held.rs`. No product code changed. Both of the review's requests are now pinned:
1. `Held::simulate_box`: `a_burn_on_a_carried_column_grid_is_the_plain_grid_burn` (an identity carry, bit-equal heights, floor 14, top 20) and `the_field_arms_refuse_a_burn_by_name` (unit). `the_field_engine_refuses_a_burn_by_name` and `the_field_view_refuses_a_burn_by_name` (integration) refuse with the exact op-prefixed `ELECTRODE_FIELD_REFUSAL`. A *document* never runs a burn on a carried grid, because `carry_turn` refuses a carry onto a non-mill first (pinned by `a_carry_onto_the_sinker_is_refused_by_name_before_any_burn`). That's safe; the misleading lathe wording is #1182.
2. `family_at_post`: `the_post_admits_a_burn_on_its_sinker`, and `the_post_refuses_a_milling_op_remounted_onto_the_sinker_by_name` (exact text; undo posts again). A burn remounted onto a mill goes stale first and never posts (`a_burn_remounted_onto_a_mill_never_posts`).

Fixes for the review of `2c1efae9` are at `a2ec0340`. Upstream main (#560, #551 merged) was already in the branch, so the merge of `upstream/main` was a no-op.

**1. camcraft-ui did not build.** I drew a new electrode glyph, `assets/ui/svg/tool-electrode.svg`. It shows a holder block, a narrow stem and a wider face block with spark ticks below it. I rasterised it with `cargo xtask icons`, which wrote `assets/ui/tool-electrode.png` and changed no other PNG; `--check` reports 0 breaches. I added `Icon::ToolElectrode` in `icons.rs` and the `ToolKind::Electrode` arm in `tool_icons.rs`. The glyph is covered by `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` "Original artwork", which applies to every `svg/*.svg`. The test `op_icon_table::every_tool_kind_has_its_own_svg_mastered_icon` (unique glyph, SVG master, never an op's glyph) passes.

**2. A Sinker Burn posted milling G-code to a sinker EDM.** Main has no EDM post door yet (#1141 is still open), so I added `posting_family::edm_at_post`. Every writer calls it right after `op_streams`: `post_script_body`, which serves `post_setup` and `post_script`; the per-mount `post_each`; and the per-op writer. It refuses any op whose setup's machine is a wire or sinker EDM before a file is written, with: `Setup1: no post for a sinker EDM machine yet (#542) - Burn0 is not posted and no file is written; an EDM dialect ships with #542`. A wire EDM names #533. The MCP `post` tool and the script `post` verb go through `post_mounts`, so they hit the same door. `op_streams` itself still admits the burn, because the sim and preview read it, and the family-door test was renamed `the_family_door_admits_a_burn_on_its_sinker`. When #542 or #1141 ship a dialect, they lift this door for the dialect they add. Pinned by:
- `sinker_burn_held::the_post_refuses_a_burn_on_its_sinker_until_an_edm_dialect_ships`: `post_setup`, `post_mounts` and `post_per_op` all refuse by name, and the scratch folder stays empty.
- `sinker_burn::the_sinker_burn_is_driven_over_mcp_with_the_gui_commands`: it now ends with the MCP `post` tool returning `isError`, the #542 text, and no file written.

I corrected the PR body's "Posting: none" claim and added the decision to `docs/decisions/541-sinker-burn-depth.md`.

**3. The plunge could feed upward with a large gap.** `crates/motion/src/sinker.rs` `check()` now refuses two cases by name:
- the tip (`burn_floor + gap`) at or above the approach plane: "the spark gap X places the tip at or above the approach plane (tip Z .., approach Z ..)";
- a gap not smaller than the burn below the work top: "the spark gap X is not smaller than the burn's Y below the work top - the electrode would never enter the work".

Pinned by `sinker_burn::a_spark_gap_that_lifts_the_tip_out_of_the_work_is_refused_by_name`. It checks gap 30 (your probe), gap 11 (tip exactly on the approach plane), gap 6 (equal to the burn), and gap 5.5 (burns, and nothing climbs past the approach plane).

**Non-blocking notes.** The `SinkerParams::model_floor_z` doc now says it is the model's global lowest Z, a coarse bound, with the box atom doing the real judging. I left the creation-time `condition_gap` check out: the condition lives on the machine, and `a_sinker_burn_needs_a_sinker_and_a_stated_condition` pins today's refusal at generate.

**Review (M3, local PR-reviewer, head-only, posted under PROCESS_VERSION 32): no code blockers, but the PR conflicts with main.** 28 files conflict against the wire EDM work (#532). Most are mechanical keep-both hunks.

**Hunks to resolve by hand:**
- **Tag collision:** main's `WireContour` holds tag and ordinal 41 (the `kinds.rs` row, `ordinal()`, `OpType` in `sel.rs`), so `SinkerBurn` takes 42. Also update the `KindInfo::ALL.len()` pin in `operation/tests.rs` and the `KIND_COUNT` assertion in `ribbon.rs`.
- **`operation/stamp.rs`:** main moved the tool digest into `stamp_tool::write`. Re-home `ToolKind::Electrode => 13`, the electrode width and the **sinker-gap digest** there. Taking main's side would silently drop the gap digest, and a changed gap would then stop marking the op stale.
- **`generate.rs`:** keep both the sinker early-return and main's wire arm. `params.rs` and `types/params.rs` are both-added arms.
- **Post paths:** compile-check `lathe_voice::at_post`'s new fourth argument in `posting_mounts.rs` and `posting_per_op.rs`.

**Laws:**
- No unwrap or panic. Provenance lines are present, and the icons are original.
- `edm_at_post` is wired into all three writers.
- The generator refuses a non-finite depth or a depth past the floor or past the electrode, a gap that lifts the tip, and a non-positive feed, each by name.
- The maintainer's earlier items (the ui build, the EDM post refusal, the gap bound) are addressed.

- tools 70, motion 199, sim 94, app lib 148.
- app: `sinker_burn` 8, `sinker_burn_held` 7, `operations` 117, `golden_cl` 25, `project_roundtrip` 71, plus others.
